column1: # targets.tsv — the canonical list of consumer repos and which shared files each
# receives. Read by sync-build-config.sh (single source of truth; keep the
# README's "Consumers" table in step with this file).
# Format: one target per line, TAB-separated:
#   <repo-dir><TAB><comma-separated files (relative to repo root and to ./config)>
# Blank lines and lines beginning with '#' are ignored.
# CLI: its Directory.Build.props is an app profile, not the shared library
# profile, so only the shared lint config is synced here.
